selectedCoreLibraryFixes.description: inflateGetDictionary could overwrite caller storage after an invalid-window-size header followed by inflateReset or inflateSync.
inflateSync before window size was known could allocate an undersized window later overrun.
inflatePrime could allow an input under-read.
Repeated deflatePrime calls could write past pending buffer.
Too-far-back distances could copy uninitialized memory to output.
Mid-stream use could read outside the window.
